title: オークスの後に・冠はなくとも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, Air Groove is unable to take first place. All the same, her satisfied fans cheer her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober, who had been struggling with her self-esteem, watches Air Groove run and realizes she wants to be just like her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling the gaze of the world upon her, Air Groove states clearly her intention to give a better performance at the Shuka Sho.
